newsitem.title: UK: Virgin, McCarthy form exec jet/helicopter co.
newsitem.headline: Virgin, McCarthy form exec jet/helicopter co.

text.p: Britain's Virgin Group and the McCarthy Corporation announced on Tuesday that they would invest an initial 10 million stg in an executive jet and helicopter business.
The company, to be called Virgin Executive Aviation Ltd, is aimed at the business and leisure travel markets.

McCarthy, an investment company run by Rory McCarthy, a pilot and business partner of Virgin boss Richard Branson, will contribute a helicopter fleet of four commercial aircraft and four trainers plus maintenance facilities.
These will form Virgin Helicopters Ltd, while Virgin Executive Jets will be launched in mid-1997 with two exective jets, which are expected to be based at London Heathrow.
Rory McCarthy was Branson's co-pilot in the abortive attempt earlier this year to fly around the world in a balloon.
